prodinfo.prodname: X-Author for Contracts Mac May 2017 User Guide

conbody.p: Using Playbook, you can mark small chunks of agreement document content as fields. When you mark content in an agreement document as a field, it becomes a smart field. Smart field values can be reconciled with data in the agreement record when the document is checked in, allowing changes made during negotiation to be accurately reflected and managed as data in Salesforce. Content marked as a field must map to the data type of existing fields in your agreement record.

note.p: Marking a field in a single agreement does not mark the field across all other documents for the same agreement record.
